description: Source code for the EnvironmentPage class in Apache Spark's master UI module, responsible for rendering environment details such as JVM info, Spark/Hadoop/System properties, classpath entries, and environment variables.

classes.name: EnvironmentPage
classes.description: A web UI page class that displays environment information for Spark master UI.

methods.description: Generates the HTML content for the environment details page based on the HTTP request.

methods.name: headerClasses
